tagline: Agents get a browser of their own.
subtitle: Beta: the Preview becomes a shared, persistent browser that agents can drive.

cards.title: Each agent browses in its Preview
cards.text: Agent-browser or Playwright, in parallel, each on its own filtered endpoint. On by default, with a switch in Settings.

cards.title: Logins that stay
cards.text: One session for every agent, kept between runs: cookies held 30 days, stored encrypted. A Site data button lists and clears them.

cards.title: Browser work as a timeline
cards.text: The chat shows what an agent did in the browser as a card, and the Preview frame says what it is doing now.

cards.title: Asks before a new site
cards.text: A site not yet allowed asks you first, in the Preview. Uploads, closing the page and clearing all cookies are refused.

also: Open the Preview when an agent starts browsing
A size the agent sets is the page's real size
footer: Beta. Try it and tell us what breaks.
